edit.description: the no-report case whose child refuses node's options before the script runs

summary: the vitest runner's no-report case ends its fixture's own arguments, so the child runs the empty script instead of refusing the flags the runner appends
acceptance: the no-report refusal case's child exits on its empty script rather than on `bad option`, and the case still reds where a missing report is read as empty
notes: Measured: `node -e "" --reporter=json` exits 9, `bad option`, before the code runs. The `refuses a run that produced no report` case passes `args: ["-e", ""]`, so its named arm — a tool that ran and wrote nothing — is never reached; the sibling case below it already spells the `--` and says why.
